info.sub_name: 全球商業永續議題選讀與討論

subTitleDesc.sub_title_en:
This course provides a foundational introduction to Sustainable Development and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Designed for first-year university students, it explores the key concepts, history, and purpose of sustainability, sustainable development, and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Students will examine how environmental, social, and economic dimensions of sustainability are interconnected and why addressing these issues is essential for creating a more just, equitable, and resilient world.
The course introduces the role of the United Nations and other international agreements in advancing sustainable development, alongside an overview of all 17 SDGs and their targets. Through case studies and real-world examples, students will analyze how governments, businesses, and civil society contribute to SDG implementation, how countries prioritize goals and indicators, and how progress is monitored and reported at national and global levels. (Emphasis on Taiwan)
subTitleDesc.sub_describe_en:
The course emphasizes participatory and transformative learning. Teaching methods include lectures, videos, discussions, group activities, and presentations, encouraging critical thinking, systems thinking, and collaborative problem-solving. Students will also explore pathways for action and reflect on how individuals and communities can become active agents of change.
By the end of the course, students will be better-informed global citizens, equipped with the knowledge, skills, and values needed to engage with sustainability challenges. An individual poster project allows students to demonstrate their understanding of a selected SDG and propose practical, actionable solutions for sustainable futures.

description.sub_name: 全球商業永續議題選讀與討論
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在幫助學生以英文進行閱讀與討論全球SDGs 議題。涵蓋的主題包含政治議題、全球經濟、健保、環境保護、種族衝突、恐怖主義與全球貧富差距。經由課堂討論分享及簡報進行，進而培養獨立思考、問題解決、社會關懷、及擁抱多元文化人格特質之國際化人才。
description.describe_eh: Through selected English readings and in-class discussions, the students are able to understand important global SDGs issues. The topics include politics, world economy, health care, environmental protection, racial conflicts, terrorism, and wealth inequality.

targets.describe_ch: 學會獨立思考、分析不同SDGs議題並提供可能解決方法
targets.describe_en: To think independently, analyze different SDGs issues and provide possible solutions.

targets.describe_en: To learn vocabulary and sentence structures to express their opinions and perspectives in class, and provide possible solutions through presentations.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Attendance - Every hour of attendance will be accounted for. 6 hours or below (2 full classes) no deduction. After two absences (above 6 hours of class time) students 1.5% will be deducted for each missing class hour

Participation - Students will be expected to participate in group discussions, mock drills, role-play, case problems, lectures, discussions and practice exams.
If quizzed or short assignments are given, the grade will be added to this 'participation' section.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Description of scoring rules
Assessments are calculated from student participation, attendance, oral reports, short written reports, group assignments and midterm/final
exams.
Students are expected to finish all assignments on time and contribute to any group discussions and article generation.
Group work is subject to group evaluations.
Bonus assignments are also available for students wishing to explore a topic in more depth and/or bolster their grades.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Be present and on-time for each class hour. This accounts for one-quarter of your final grade
2. Participate actively in class. This is also a substantial part of the final grade.
3. Do not be late (over 10 minutes) or leave early (without permission), otherwise it will be counted as absence.
4. No foul or inappropriate language allowed. You are going to be asked to leave.
5. Be considerate and polite to all. Help us create a positive classroom atmosphere.
6. Treat everyone with respect. Discrimination or harassment will be dealt with according to the university guidelines.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Each student must fulfill all parts of the class assessment.
2. We are here to share and learn from each other.
3. Do not hesitate to ask questions or seek clarification at any point during the class, afterwards or via email.
4. Please try to maintain a positive mood and learning attitude.
5. If you do not like the course you may drop at any time.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
The primary purpose of this course is for students to actively learn and develop their own idenpendent critical thinking skills. What is valued most are students' own
analysis of discussed phenomenon and then putting forward their viewpoint. In other words developing and articulating a solid argument. It is discouraged to simply
assume the ideas of others without giving them a proper thought.
 
A secondary aim is to encourage students to work collaboratively in groups in order to generate cohesive and comprehensive written reports and presentations.
Cheating, copying or using AI for generating answers is absolutely forbidden. This will result in immediate failure from the course and will be reported to the university.
